subject: Marine Works - Repairs - Vancouver Harbour
text:
Marine Works - Repairs - Vancouver Harbour
Concrete and timber repairs will take place at Pembina Vancouver Wharves from Berth 1 to Berth 5. 
Hours of operation from 1300 to 0030 UTC daily from 02 Nov to 01 Dec. 
Vancouver Pile Driving vessel on site monitoring VHF channel 64A.
Minimum wake.
